answer: Each identity must win one slot in the nebula registry: slots sell each epoch in a uniform-price auction and every winner pays the clearing price. One honest bid clears at 10 credits; each added fake must outbid the rest, lifting the clearing price 2 credits per fake, so the kth fake pays 10 + 2k and N fakes cost 10N + N(N+1) credits. Fakes bid against themselves down to the nadir of the book, and the sonnet of bids is public, so ten fakes cost 210 credits and a hundred cost 11,100.
